The '''''Lucky Lekku''''' was a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], notably during the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Lucky_Lekku_noseart.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Noseart of the ''Lucky Lekku'']]
The [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] had nose art of a blue-skinned [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] female in [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]] on both its sides. It had the standard armament of a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]], but it lacked the two [[composite-beam laser]] turrets that were otherwise located behind the cockpit.

==History==
===Battle of Teth===
This ship was first seen during the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]] where it launched an attack on a [[B'omarr Monastery]], which was used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] as a hiding place for the kidnapped [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]], the son of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. The gunship took heavy fire from several of the [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droids]] stationed at the monastery, but it came out of the battle all in one piece.<ref name="TCWf">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>

===Battle of Rishi moon===
On the [[Rishi moon]] the ship was used to search for any surviving [[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]] after the [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|destruction]] of [[Rishi Station/Legends|Rishi Station]].<ref name="Rookies">{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}}</ref>

===Battle of Ryloth===
During the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]] the gunship was briefly seen in the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] of the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Skywalker]].<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth">{{TCW|Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref>

===Second Battle of Geonosis===
On [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] the ship was used as a troop transport to quickly deploy [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to the surface of Geonosis. The gunship was one of the lucky ones, as many of the other [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] were shot down by the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Proton cannon/Legends|proton cannons]], [[LR1K sonic cannon/Legends|LR1K sonic cannons]] and [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="LaPR">{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}}</ref>

===Defense of Cato Neimoidia===
During the [[Defense of Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Defense of Cato Neimoidia]], the gunship was deployed to the planet to deliver [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] to the battlefield.<ref name="Sabotage">{{TCW|Sabotage (episode)}}</ref> By this time it had amassed at least 88 kills.

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Lucky Lekku'' (in LEGO version) is the design set for all gunships in ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'' apart from multiplayer when playing Jedi Crash as it is symbolised with the [[Crumb Bomber/Legends|''Crumb Bomber'']].

The nose art appears to be inspired by A B-24 Liberator Bomber "Night Mission" from the 30th Bomb Group, 819th Bomb Squadron of the USAAF 7th Air Force.
